verdict.rationale: Weave's built-in and custom signals are its own documented feature for automatically classifying live agent interactions, and Guardrails ships pre-built safety and quality scorers, which together approximate continuous online evaluation. The core `Evaluation` workflow, however, is documented only against a Dataset of test examples. missing for 10: explicit docs on attaching scorers/LLM judges to run continuously on incoming production traces (online evaluation configuration, sampling, scheduling), detail on how signals execute, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can run evaluators continuously on live production traffic, not just offline datasets

citations.quote: Built-in and custom signals automatically capture and classify agent interactions, so you always know how your agents are behaving.
Create a custom W\&B Weave signal to tag agent turns for a behavior you define.
Weave Guardrails offers pre-built scorers for safety and quality to support responsible AI.
out-of-the-box signals to surface failure modes
